excerpt: Mara Vale makes cooperative puzzle games. A collaborator supplied the visual cues and pause control requirements; Mara added the persistent latch after a playtest. Drafts include selected AI suggestions, light copy edits, and an unreviewed generated claim. All people, records and dates here are fictional.

facts.label: First playtest
facts.quote: Mara's handwritten notes describe players waiting at the door. The original instruction draft predates any AI session.

facts.label: Review recordings
facts.quote: Three pairs of players were observed. The second pair had an unreliable controller; the third had prior puzzle exposure.

facts.label: Access review
facts.quote: A collaborator's checklist already required paired sound and visual cues and a pause control. Mara added the persistent latch after the one-handed playtest.

facts.label: Draft with an assistant
facts.quote: An assistant proposed 'room to notice'; Mara selected and revised that phrasing. A later automated assembly step generated a universal-inclusion claim after her final review.

facts.label: Copy edit and response
facts.quote: Mara accepted shortening edits and restored the controller detail. Her draft already cautioned against guarantees. An automated assembly step then inserted a guarantee she never reviewed; the publication copy contradicts her draft's caution.
